tameable-foxes.config.foxTamingItems.des: Change or add items that is needed to tame a fox.
tameable-foxes.config.foxBreedingItems.d: Change or add items that is needed to breed a fox.
tameable-foxes.config.foxesAttackWithOwn: If true, foxes will attack the mobs owner hits.
If false, foxes can only be tamed by breeding them.
tameable-foxes.config.foxesCanIgnoreMobG: If true, foxes will still pick items even if /gamerule mobGriefing set to false.
tameable-foxes.config.foxesTrustOnBorn.d: If true, when two foxed are bred, the baby will directly trust you and be tamed.
